tldr: A prospective balanced experiment identifies two income CDF contrasts while their joint assignment uncertainty depends on unobserved potential-outcome associations. The focal object is the sharp common 95 percent radius \(r^*(q)\) under the specified rejection design. Strict cycle cancellation reduces every least-favourable three-category completion to at most four smooth acyclic covariance patches. Comonotone completion is strictly suboptimal on an open positive-margin region containing inputs with two nonzero loading coordinates; the exact positive-margin fixture \(q^B\) is comonotone-optimal. A finite stationary-value criterion characterizes the full mathematical frontier, while complete effective certification at exact stationary ties remains open. Replayable radius enclosures and an observed-margin band yield uniform asymptotic simultaneous honesty. Oracle minimality concerns only common-width rectangles centered at the specified estimator.
gap: Scalar causal-bootstrap completion and rerandomization limit theory do not characterize the nonlinear joint critical radius. Exact stationary ties separate boundary membership from positive-tolerance numerical optimization.
fill: Acyclic flow geometry supplies an explicit low-dimensional optimizer domain, the stationary-value frontier supplies the exact global boundary, and certified radii plus observed margins supply feasible uniform coverage. Complete exact-input component and equality certification remains a first-class open question.
